items.title: Warren Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995
items.q: I did my first overseas trip in 1974 with Benny and John Bunch and Bucky Pizzarelli, Barrett Deems, and I think Urbie was on that one, Peter Appleyard on vibes.

ctx.x: Did you get to go overseas with him?
Yeah, I did my first overseas trip in 1974 with Benny and John Bunch and Bucky Pizzarelli, Barrett Deems, and I think Urbie was on that one, Peter Appleyard on vibes.
Tell us about your association with Scott Hamilton and how that came about.
